title: Nested Dictionaries for an Interactive Story
description: Store room narratives and next-room choices in a nested dictionary and look them up using a room variable.

steps.description: Create an empty dictionary story, add an inner dictionary at story['start'], and populate its 'narrative' string and 'next' list of destination rooms.
Set the current room variable room = 'start'.

steps.question: When room is 'start', what values do story[room]['narrative'] and story[room]['next'] look up?
steps.answer: story[room] accesses story['start'], so story[room]['narrative'] returns 'It was a dark and stormy night...' and story[room]['next'] returns the list ['forest', 'diner'].

steps.description: Print the current room's narrative on line 8 and its list of next rooms on line 9.
Inspect the nested story dictionary and room variable in memory as lines 8 and 9 print the start room.
